title: Spending Billions Annually on Large Models! Meta Exposed to Invest Heavily in Anthropic

content_html:
The arms race of large models is entering a more imaginative capital game. According to reports cited by Cailian News, Meta internally predicted this year that its annual spending on AI models from Anthropic could reach as high as $10 billion in the future.

As a leading force in the global large model field, Anthropic has built a solid technical barrier in areas such as long-text processing, complex logical reasoning, and enterprise-level application ecosystems with its Claude series models.

This potential billion-dollar spending by Meta not only reflects the high dependence of tech giants on top third-party large models when advancing cutting-edge artificial intelligence research and business applications, but also further highlights the unprecedented enthusiasm for cross-giant technological collaboration and resource investment in the current large model ecosystem.
